description: Search the summer camp directory by camp name or town, optionally within a state and by type (day, overnight, family). Returns each camp's id, town, ages, accreditation, its page, and watchUrl — the link a parent opens to get emailed when a seat opens. "watched: true" means live session status is available from get_camp.

offset.description: Camps to skip, for the next page.

query.description: Camp name or town words, e.g. "pine hollow" or "austin".

state.description: Two-letter state code or state name, e.g. "CA" or "New York".

name: search_camps
title: Search camps
